sections.label: Overview
paragraphs: Te Whāriki Manawāhine o Hauraki is the proposed visual identity for Hauraki Refuge — a kaupapa Māori service providing wraparound support for whānau. Its guiding whakataukī: ‘Hauraki, the healing place of unseen wounds.’

The brief was a brand system rooted in land, culture, and quiet strength — one that feels like a person, not a policy. Every decision moves away from the busy toward the essential, finding the quiet strength at the heart of the organisation.

sections.label: Colour Palette
paragraphs: Every colour was drawn from the Hauraki landscape — dark forest floor, native bush, the glimmer of tidal light. Together they communicate safety, depth, and quiet healing.

items.name: The forest at rest
items.desc: Three forest greens — Pō, Ngahere, Uru — create a quiet, enveloping atmosphere. Dark backgrounds remove visual noise and invite the visitor to slow down, mirroring the experience of entering a safe, sheltered space.

items.name: Growth & healing
items.desc: Kākāriki and pounamu tones carry deep significance in te ao Māori — life, renewal, the vitality of the land. The dual teal registers let the brand feel grounded and alive, never cold or clinical.

items.name: Warmth & welcome
items.desc: Cream and white — Maramara, Kō — carry a warmth pure white cannot. They feel human and worn, like a letter, like a kōrero around a table, keeping the brand inviting rather than institutional.

items.name: You are safe here
items.desc: The movement from dark to teal to warm light mirrors a journey from protection into healing. No harsh contrast, no alarm — only depth, movement, and quiet care.

sections.label: Logo & Identity
paragraphs: A refinement of the original — the tukutuku (weaved panels) form carried forward, simplified and distilled to its quiet essence. At the base, two kōru curl inward and cross, their forms embracing as if holding something gently between them: a symbol of shelter, of safe hands.

items.alt: Te Whāriki mark — reverse on light
items.caption: Reverse — on light

items.name: Minimal & Uncluttered
items.desc: Strip back decorative elements. The mark should breathe — generous whitespace, no competing details. Simplicity signals confidence.

items.name: Warm, Not Corporate
items.desc: Avoid geometric rigidity. The logo should feel like it belongs to people, not an institution. Soft, approachable forms invite rather than impose.

items.name: Bilingual by Nature
items.desc: Te reo Māori is primary. The mark holds both the full name and the English identifier with equal visual dignity.

sections.label: Typography
sections.html:
Two voices. One classical, one contemporary. Together they carry the weight of the mahi and the warmth of the people it serves.

Display / H1 — Cormorant Garamond, Light 300

Haere Mai

Heading / H2 — Cormorant Garamond, Regular 400

A place of healing, story, and connection.

Body — DM Sans, Light 300 · 15px · line-height 1.8

Te Whāriki provides wraparound support for whānau. We walk alongside people — not ahead, not behind.

Label / Tag — DM Sans, Bold · tracked

TĀNE WHAKAPIRIPIRI — MEN'S WELLBEING SERVICE

items.name: Grounded
items.desc: Rooted in place and kaupapa Māori. The voice speaks with earned authority — not loudly, but with quiet certainty.

items.name: Inviting
items.desc: People arriving in difficult moments need to feel welcome before they feel helped. Language is an open door — warm without being performative.

items.name: Honest
items.desc: No jargon. No over-promising. Honest language builds trust — especially with people who have been let down before.

items.name: Generous Whitespace
items.desc: Space is breathing room, not emptiness. Minimum 48px between sections, 24px between elements. Let each item land before the next arrives.

items.name: Clear Hierarchy
items.desc: One dominant headline, supporting body, a quiet label. Never more than three levels of visual weight on a single screen — the eye should know instantly where to go first.

items.name: Left-Anchored Structure
items.desc: Content reads left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Anchor key identifiers to the left; centre-align display headlines only.

items.name: Depth Through Layers
items.desc: Use the three background tones to create depth without shadows or heavy borders — cards lift off the page through colour alone.

sections.label: Imagery Direction
paragraphs: Photography sets the emotional register before a single word is read. The brand draws from landscape, marae, and the quiet dignity of daily life in Hauraki — natural light, muted grading, and subjects shown with dignity and agency.
